name: 4-Quattro Pro
description: The lightest weight, most powerful boot in its class. A reinforced cuff works with the Alpine Axial system for precise, high-performance alpine fit. Secure Speed Lock 4 provides extra security when charging down a couloir. Purpose built for free rides in search of the steepest, most challenging lines on the planet.
highlights: Lightest freeride boot on the market
characteristics: New cuff with rigid structure in the back, lowered at front for faster impulse transmission
New liner with plastic tongue construction
sustainability: Shell and cuff made of Pebax Rnew
Footbed made of Recycled Ortholite Foam
Booster Power Strap is PVC Free

name: 4-Quattro GT
description: The 4-Quattro GT is designed with a slightly higher volume last to expand the fit range of the Quattro line. The warmest Quattro model, blending comfort and performance for those looking for a hybrid boot for long days on the slopes playing or working.
characteristics: Alpine Axial Hybrid construction for easier entry and excellent impulse transmission
Higher volume for more accommodating fit
Boot sole length 9mm longer than all other 4-Quattro models
Multi-layer footbed to keep feet warmer
shell_cuff_tongue: High Performance PU / High Performance PU / Pebax
sustainability: Shell and cuff made of Desmopan CQ MBC, entirely PVC Free
Footbed made with recycled Ortholite Foam
Intuition Liner upper fabric made of recycled materials
